comment: C-first cheap variation of the anti-magic trap route. The matched-source baseline revealed Wizard starts wearing a cloak of magic resistance (u_init.c:Wizard), activating Antimagic in the trap. This variation uses T then the C/source-derived inventory letter b to remove that starting cloak before wishing the same trap and triggering it. It tests the same source function with Antimagic false; exact C menu and outcome must be recorded before JS comparison.
